tools.name: atisbo_orient
tools.description: Workspace orientation. Modes: snapshot (overview), whats_new (delta), strategy, integrations. Continue the user's existing workflow; never create a parallel backlog. Living docs cite snippet:// refs: open cited Signals with atisbo_lookup mode=open, use claim depth=work for the full corpus, and atisb

tools.name: atisbo_lookup
tools.description: Find or open Atisbo entities. work_queue returns an external agent action_queue, completion, Monitoring and pm_exceptions. outcome_review exposes post-launch evidence; implementation_context loads product intent. Mutate with atisbo_decide or atisbo_map.

tools.name: atisbo_capture
tools.description: Capture feedback or knowledge. Modes: signal; signal_batch (idempotent by client_request_id); knowledge; update_artefact (full replace); patch_artefact (preferred—get content_hash with atisbo_lookup mode=doc_patch_context); add_artefact_evidence.

tools.name: atisbo_decide
tools.description: PM decision facade. CURATE: evidence review/grouping, deal-breakers. EXECUTE: create, update, dispatch or delete Solutions, record Outcomes. DOCUMENT/GOVERN: living docs, coverage, schedules, knowledge, strategy. log_decision is only for external decisions; mutations log themselves. Writes require U

tools.name: atisbo_map
tools.description: Compact facade for map work: create/apply maps, generate/edit nodes and edges, anchor claims/snippets, bind metrics, manage claim-snipe maps, regroup claims (merge/split — mode=regroup). Prefer mode=apply for full MECE categorization. TWO WAYS TO PUT A CLAIM ON A NODE, not interchangeable: mode=anch

tools.name: atisbo_connect
tools.description: Compact facade for WHERE Atisbo gets its signals — it CONNECTS sources, not just describes them. Modes: list (connections + live status), catalog (ingestible sources; query filters), create (returns the endpoint), configure, pause, resume, sync_now (pull sources only). Call list before any mutation.

tools.name: atisbo_analyze
tools.description: Broad analytical query over claims, solutions, or activity: time filters, grouping, metrics, ready-to-render chart artifact. Use FIRST for analytical questions spanning entities or time windows; for single-entity drill-downs atisbo_lookup mode=claim or atisbo_lookup mode=node is enough.

tools.name: atisbo_support
tools.description: Diagnose Atisbo, including "I connected a source and nothing appeared", "I sent text and no opportunity formed", or "my data is missing". Checks integrations, ingestion, clustering, gates and key scope, then returns a playbook. share_report files only diagnostics plus your text—never feedback, custo

findings.detail: Description of "atisbo_connect" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: atisbo_lookup, atisbo_connect · Private data: atisbo_decide, atisbo_connect, atisbo_support · Public sink: atisbo_lookup, atisbo_connect · Destructive: atisbo_decide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: atisbo_lookup, atisbo_connect · Private data: atisbo_decide, atisbo_connect, atisbo_support · Public sink: atisbo_lookup, atisbo_connect · Destructive: atisbo_decide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
